name: ArenaFileRejection
description: The files the last pick or drop refused, by reason, each a list of names. A file is refused for one reason: a wrong type is reported before a size, and surplus counts only files that passed both.

tooLarge.description: Names of the files larger than `maxSize`.

wrongType.description: Names of the files `accept` does not match.

surplus.description: Names of the accepted files that did not fit: every one after the first in a single drop on a field that holds one file.
